reviews.text: Dana is a highly sensitive person who can connect with both dogs and their owners with great empathy. She's highly knowledgeable and competent, and shares her experience with genuine passion. Highly recommended, thanks from Zoe and Lucia!

Dana is competent, patient, and welcoming. She knows how to listen and understand the dog's needs and any difficulties the human may have. She has a sense of humor (which helps make certain situations seem lighthearted, rather than superficial), and is always present and consistent. Viviana & Mirko

We turned to Dana for our puppy's emotional insecurities, after meeting another trainer with whom we didn't get along. Dana is a whole other world: introspective, relational, logical, competent, and passionate, as well as available for any of our questions or needs. Thank you!

I started a training program with Dana less than two months ago, primarily to learn how to better manage my dachshund's recall and his discomfort when left home alone. We're making great progress in both areas and are truly satisfied with the support, expertise, and availability Dana is offering us.

I also want to emphasize that, in my opinion, you don't need to have a specific problem to undertake dog training. For us, it's becoming an invaluable experience, helping us better understand our dog, his characteristics, and his needs, so we can satisfy him and make him happy in the way that best suits him.

I highly recommend Dana to anyone who wants to build a more informed and peaceful relationship with their dog.

Brugo thanks you too ❤️

It was a truly positive experience.
Dana is a knowledgeable, patient trainer who truly cares about each dog's needs.
Thanks to her lessons and advice, Ciko has gained greater confidence, concentration, and body awareness, while having fun at the same time. I highly recommend Dana to anyone who wants to share a fun and educational experience with their dog.

I asked Dana for help because my shepherdess has started to be afraid of firecrackers/thunderstorms/loud, sudden noises. She's teaching us various exercises and activities that we can do both indoors and outdoors to manage her fear, and we're already seeing good results!
The classroom spaces are huge and completely green, with lots of trees providing shade, so we don't die from the heat under the sun. There's also various equipment (platforms, tunnels, wheels) for various exercises. Highly recommended.

We started the program with Dana because my dog ​​is very fearful and living in a big city isn't easy for her. The goal is to help her feel more confident and enjoy walking more peacefully.
Even though we're still working together, she's already given us a lot of helpful advice, and we're starting to see the first results. What I appreciate most about Dana is the attention she pays not only to the dog's well-being, but also to the relationship between dog and owner. During the lessons, we learn so much and create wonderful moments and memories to share together. Thank you!
Dana is great, my dog ​​loves her, and the exercises she taught us helped him a lot. She didn't just teach us exercises, but a real method for better interacting with Leopoldo.

Our Otto is very happy to go to Dana's class; he has a blast and learns about searching, retrieving, and managing waiting. We're thrilled to have Dana as our educator; she teaches us how to manage our approach to Otto and shares tips and situations we're dealing with on our own.

We've started a program with Dana for my crazy dachshund, and she's helping us tremendously to moderate his exuberant nature. She's always very helpful and kind, both with the dog and with his owners (which is no small feat). We can't wait to continue this adventure together!
Highly recommended!
